global: A bowl of spicy ramen broth, rich and red, cradles tender chashu pork. Topped with fresh cilantro, bean sprouts, and chopped green onions, it sits in a rustic white bowl against a dark, warmly lit surface.

regions.background: Dark brown wooden table surface with subtle grain patterns and a warm light reflection on its right side.
regions.bowl: The ceramic bowl has a speckled off-white glaze, smooth curved rim, and subtle concentric ridges near its base.
regions.soup: The spicy broth is deep red, oily, and speckled with chili flakes, bean sprouts, green onions, and a large cilantro garnish.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, layered texture with light brown color and visible fat marbling, garnished with cilantro.
